newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iraq buys up to 275,000 tns French wheat.
newsitem.headline: Iraq buys up to 275,000 tns French wheat.

text.p: Iraq has finalised contracts to buy between 250,000 and 275,000 tonnes of French wheat for March and April at prices between $184 and $185 per tonne, European grain traders said on Wednesday.
The price includes cost and freight, they said.
Baghdad has also lined up new purchases of at least 100,000 tonnes of wheat from Australia with money raised from its recent oil-for-food pact with the United Nations, they said.
French exporters had been negotiating for days to sell more wheat to Iraq, subject to U.N. approval, following previous sales of 300,000 tonnes of French wheat in December.
Iraq was officially seeking 100,000 tonnes of French wheat for March or April delivery but traders said there had been speculation the final deal would cover up to 325,000 tonnes.
U.N. officials said on Friday that more than $100 million had been received in U.N. accounts set up to handle oil revenues raised by Baghdad's renewable six-month deal with the U.N.
